author: reek
body: A shaded, spinning 3D cube rendered from Codex [Device] AST. One GPU thread per pixel casts a ray, inverse-rotates it into the cube's local frame (so the cube appears to spin), slab-tests it against the unit box, picks the entry face for a per-face colour, and shades it with a fixed local key light. This is the gateway to the reference site's mesh demos -- real 3D geometry rendered per pixel from Codex, no fixed-function vertex stage. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: tmin/tmax slab test in local space; the axis whose near-plane is the entry (equals tmin) gives the face normal (pointing against the ray on that axis). Lighting is in local space with a fixed key light, so the shading spins with the cube.
